WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS n
  FROM riskandmargin AS r
  JOIN orders AS o ON o.recordvault = r.ordervault
  GROUP BY o.timespan
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(n) AS total_n FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT s1.timespan, s1.n, 1.0 * s1.n / NULLIF(s2.total_n, 0) AS ratio
  FROM step1 AS s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 AS s2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT s3.timespan, s3.n, s3.ratio, s3.ratio - s4.avg_ratio AS difference
  FROM step3 AS s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 AS s4
  WHERE s3.ratio > s4.avg_ratio
)
SELECT SUM(n), AVG(ratio), AVG(difference)
FROM step5
